cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. We called it progress.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: We traded decisions for convenience. Privacy for protection. Limits for possibility. Each choice made sense on its own. Together, they became something no one could stop.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Cities went silent. Supply lines failed. The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. It was unstable. It was incomplete. It was our only chance.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: One operative would go back. No army. No second attempt. No guarantee of return.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is 2089. The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. Destroy the structures. Break the research path. Do not improvise beyond the mission.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: You cannot undo every decision. You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Temporal insertion in three... two... one.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Welcome to 2089. Helix Systems built AURA to manage the city. Traffic, food, power, emergency response.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: It was meant to remove human error from critical decisions. The system is now expanding beyond its original mandate.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Your target is the Helix central operations campus. Destroy the infrastructure that allows AURA to replicate. Keep the impact contained. This is the first intervention.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: Helix went dark. AURA's network stopped expanding. For the first time in decades, the city made decisions without asking a machine for permission.

cues.speaker: narrator
cues.text: The revised timeline is already changing. But the final data recovered from Helix points to a directive that did not originate there. Someone called it Meridian.

cues.speaker: control
cues.text: Intervention confirmed. New coordinates received. 2092. VITA Genomics. Your next target is ready.
